title.official: Seizing the opportunities of safe, secure and trustworthy artificial intelligence systems for sustainable development
title.short: UNGA resolution 78/265 on AI systems for sustainable development

relevance.reason: The first United Nations General Assembly resolution devoted to artificial intelligence. It is a political, non-binding resolution that recognises opportunities and risks of AI systems and calls for safe, secure and trustworthy AI, international cooperation and capacity-building, especially for developing countries. It creates no treaty obligation.
ai_provisions: Preamble — opportunities and risks of AI for sustainable development and human rights
Operative paragraphs — safe, secure and trustworthy AI systems; international cooperation; capacity-building; bridging digital divides
relevance.excluded_scope: Non-binding General Assembly resolution; no monitoring or enforcement mechanism; it does not address military AI.
